【原视频简介】
This is a small project I created using Blender 4.4, incorporating the NPR branch from its beta version. I aimed to achieve a 'slice of life' vibe in an anime-style short animation, and it truly felt worthwhile for me. I hope you all enjoy it! All project files related to this are available on my Patreon.
